description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Onion Knight
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Blowback (0~2), removed after using Apex Blowback two times

description.name: Apex Blowback Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Blowback level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Onion Knight]

description.name: Apex Blowback Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Blowback level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Onion Knight]
